title: Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update
title_zh: Artemis：基于几何的多智能体驾驶世界模型——共享三维状态与渐进式记忆更新

paragraphs.en: Recent video world models have witnessed the paradigm shift from single-agent to multi-agent involvements, which can reveal more complicated dynamics and cross-agent interaction in the real world. However, existing approaches commonly adopt implicit inter-agent communications via cross attention, which lack explicit geometry constraints and unified 3D state, thereby leading to poor multi-view consistency and struggling with recovering out-of-sight agents. In addition, most of them assume a static background, failing to represent uncontrolled background dynamics. To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA, with scalable agent numbers, physical plausibility, and abundant interaction modes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents, and flexibly switch between single-camera or multi-camera setting. Project page: https://liujiuming123.github.io/Artemis/ .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频世界模型见证了从单智能体到多智能体参与的范式转变，这能够揭示现实世界中更为复杂的动态和智能体间的交互。 然而，现有方法通常通过交叉注意力实现隐式的智能体间通信，这种方式缺乏明确的几何约束和统一的三维状态，从而导致多视角一致性差，并难以恢复视野之外的智能体。 此外，大多数方法都假设背景是静态的，无法表示不受控制的背景动态。 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 Artemis：一种基于几何的多智能体世界模型，具备显式的记忆共享机制。 通过多智能体的观测重建出显式的三维世界地图，以在所有智能体间强制执行统一的三维状态，从而实现高跨视角一致性。 具体而言，我们开发了一个动作引导的几何注入模块，可同时渲染分解的前景-背景控制图，并通过一个定制的 GeoAdapter 块将其注入到扩散变换器中。 与以往仅假设静态背景的方法不同，我们的 GeoAdapter 还能区分不受控制的非智能体动态，这些动态基于其自身多帧历史位置进行条件约束，以提供一致的运动线索。 从渐进式视频展开中选取的关键帧被用于逐步更新重建的三维世界地图。 为有效捕捉复杂的动态模式，我们构建了一个名为 MA-CARLA 的新数据集，该数据集从 CARLA 模拟器中采样，具备可扩展的智能体数量、物理合理性以及丰富的交互模式。 广泛的实验表明，在生成的视频中，我们提出的方法在视觉保真度和跨视角一致性方面均表现出优越性。 此外，我们的 Artemis 能够支持同时执行多模态展开，并维护二维视频和三维点云地图；可扩展至超过两个智能体的场景，并能灵活地在单摄像头或多摄像头设置之间切换。 项目页面：https://liujiuming123.github.io/Artemis/ .

paragraphs.en: Video world models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Po et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) can predict future environmental dynamics given historical observations and actions from users or agents, which have recently achieved remarkable success in autonomous driving ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026d ; Liu et al., 2026c ) , embodied AI ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Seo et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2026b ) , and immersive game engines ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . However, early methods are mostly constrained by a single-agent perspective, which cannot reflect the intrinsic multi-agent interactions and complex dynamics in the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018；Po 等，2025；Wu 等，2025；Liu 等，2025；Zhao 等，2025）能够根据用户或智能体的历史观测和行动预测未来的环境动态，这些模型最近在自动驾驶（Wang 等，2024；Zhao 等，2025；Liu 等，2026d；Liu 等，2026c）、具身人工智能（Lu 等，2025；Seo 等，2023；Huang 等，2026b）以及沉浸式游戏引擎（Yu 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025）领域取得了显著成功。 然而，早期的方法大多局限于单一智能体的视角，无法反映真实世界中内在的多智能体交互和复杂动态。

paragraphs.en: To effectively extend to multi-agent interactive world models, some recent approaches attempt to achieve inter-agent information exchange in a shared world. As a pioneering work, Solaris ( Savva et al., 2026 ) curates a novel multiplayer dataset in gaming scenes and introduces shared self-attention layers for cross-agent correlation. Subsequent methods further improve it with scalability in agent numbers ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , accurate agent positional encoding ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , and world state alignment ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了有效扩展到多智能体交互式世界模型，一些近期的方法试图在共享世界中实现智能体之间的信息交换。 作为开创性工作，Solaris（Savva 等人，2026）在游戏场景中构建了一个新颖的多玩家数据集，并引入了共享自注意力层以实现跨智能体的相关性。 后续的方法通过提升智能体数量的可扩展性（Liu 等人，2026a；Wu 等人，2026）、精确的智能体位置编码（Sun 等人，2026；Liu 等人，2026a）以及世界状态对齐（Wu 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2026）进一步改进了这一方法。

paragraphs.en: However, these multi-agent approaches commonly struggle with three challenges: (1) Lack of explicit geometric constraint for cross-view consistency : The physical environment and action-triggered events should evolve consistently and be faithfully reflected from all agents’ perspectives. This requires a globally consistent understanding of geometric structures and visual appearances across all agents. MultiWorld ( Wu et al., 2026 ) proposes an action attention and reweighting module to maintain a global state. However, their inter-agent association is still established on implicit cross attention, lacking sufficient geometric cues to ensure multi-view consistency. (2) Limited memory sharing : Basically, diverse agents execute their actions and exist in the same shared world, which means that historical observed frames across agents may share high overlap, especially in scenarios when another agent revisits the same location. Therefore, sufficient historical memory sharing is crucial to further strengthen a unified world state and facilitate cross-agent information reuse. However, existing methods ( Savva et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) mostly fail to consider effective cross-agent geometry sharing beyond the current timestamp. (3) Over-simplified scene complexity and dynamics : Previous methods typically evaluate the multi-agent interaction in the synthetic gameplay scenario where dynamics are quite simplified to reveal the true world evolution, leading to uncertain generalization capabilities in scaling agent complexity, memorizing out-of-sight dynamics, and handling severe occlusions in complex world distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些多智能体方法通常面临三个挑战：(1) 缺乏用于跨视角一致性的显式几何约束：物理环境和由动作触发的事件应保持一致地演化，并能够从所有智能体的视角中得到忠实反映。 这要求所有智能体对几何结构和视觉外观形成全局一致的理解。 MultiWorld（Wu 等人，2026）提出了一种动作注意力和重新加权模块，以维持全局状态。 然而，它们之间的智能体关联仍然建立在隐式交叉注意力之上，缺乏足够的几何线索来确保多视角一致性。 (2) 有限的记忆共享：基本上，不同的智能体在同一个共享世界中执行其动作并存在，这意味着跨智能体的历史观测帧可能存在高度重叠，尤其是在另一个智能体重新访问同一位置的场景中。 因此，充分的历史记忆共享对于进一步巩固统一的世界状态和促进跨智能体信息重用至关重要。 然而，现有方法（Savva 等人，2026；Wu 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2026）大多未能考虑超越当前时间戳的有效跨智能体几何共享。 (3) 过度简化的场景复杂性和动态性：先前的方法通常在合成游戏场景中评估多智能体交互，其中动态被大幅简化以揭示真实的世界演化，这导致在扩展智能体复杂性、记忆视野之外的动态变化以及处理复杂世界分布中的严重遮挡方面存在不确定的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: To address these bottlenecks, we propose Artemis, a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with shared explicit 3D state and memory. Rather than implicit-only agent association, our method constructs a 3D global point cloud-based world map with cross-view consistency to address the first challenge. Explicit geometric constraints are then rendered as control maps and then injected into Diffusion Transformer (DiT) through GeoAdapter, enabling global-aware and view-invariant video generation for each agent. Specifically, we decompose the scene into static background, action-controlled foreground agents, and uncontrolled background dynamics. Static geometry and controlled agents’ proxies provide background and foreground RGB and depth control maps, respectively, while uncontrolled non-agent dynamics further require multi-frame historical control maps providing consistent motion tendency for future synthesis.

paragraphs.en: For the second bottleneck, we further introduce two novel designs to facilitate effective cross-agent memory sharing: (1) World map sharing. We progressively select keyframes revealing significantly unobserved areas from new generated videos across all agents to update a global world map. In this case, different agents can explicit share a consistent 3D world state with multi-view matching priors. (2) Relative pose sharing. During autoregressive rollout, persistent agent proxies are propagated using cross-agent relative poses and updated from rolling-out videos. Another benefit of maintaining relative pose is that, when an unrepresented controlled agent is expected to enter the view, a pose-dependent visibility test can initialize its proxy. To address the third challenge, we curate a novel dataset from the CARLA simulator in complex urban scenarios called MA-CARLA, which provides scalable multi-camera sampling, abundant interaction modes, physical plausibility, and diverse environmental dynamics.

paragraphs.en: Interactive Video World Models. World models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) can predict future environmental dynamics given historical observations and actions. With rapid advances in recent video diffusion transformers, there is increasing research interest resorting to action-conditioned video generation backbones ( Wan et al., 2025 ) for world modeling. Recently, interactivity has become a crucial property in world models where users can immersively navigate, manipulate, and personalize their created worlds in a multi-round paradigm. As a milestone, Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) compresses the video features into latent space with VAE and then learn actions unsupervisedly, supporting minute-level video generation and interactive exploration. Subsequent world models focus on achieving long-horizon consistency ( Po et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , effective memory design ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , or real-time rollout ( Chen et al., 2026c ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) . However, most of video world models enforce a single-agent formulation with a first-person or third-person perspective, with limited agent numbers and exploration flexibility ( Liu et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 交互式视频世界模型。 世界模型（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018）能够在给定历史观测和行动的情况下预测未来环境的动态变化。 随着近期视频扩散变换器的快速发展，利用以行动为条件的视频生成主干网络（Wan 等，2025）进行世界建模的研究兴趣日益浓厚。 最近，交互性已成为世界模型的一项关键特性，用户可以在多轮交互的框架中沉浸式地导航、操控和个性化他们创建的世界。 作为一项里程碑式成果，Genie（Bruce 等，2024）通过 VAE 将视频特征压缩到潜在空间，然后无监督地学习行动，从而支持分钟级的视频生成和交互式探索。 后续的世界模型则专注于实现长期一致性（Po 等，2025；Huang 等，2026a；Wang 等，2026）、有效的记忆设计（Wu 等，2025；Xiao 等，2025；Hong 等，2025；Chen 等，2026a）或实时展开（Chen 等，2026c；Huang 等，2025；Zhu 等，2026a）。 然而，大多数视频世界模型都采用单智能体设定，并局限于第一人称或第三人称视角，同时智能体的数量与探索灵活性也有限（Liu 等，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Agent Video World Models. To capture inter-instance interactions, MultiVerse ( team, 2025 ) proposes the first multiplayer gaming world model by trivially concatenating each agent’s video and action tokens along the channel dimension for denoising together. Solaris ( Savva et al., 2026 ) further designs a shared self-attention and per-player ID embeddings. Nevertheless, its per-slot embeddings break the permutation-symmetry requirement for each agent. Moreover, Solaris suffers from poor generalization to arbitrary agent numbers due to quadratic-complexity full attention. To address these problems, Gamma-World ( Liu et al., 2026a ) introduces a regular simplex in rotary angle space to achieve equidistant agent embeddings and sparse hub attention to decrease computational costs. MultiWorld ( Wu et al., 2026 ) constructs the testbed on the ItTakesTwo game and develops adaptive weighting in multi-agent action space. To strengthen view consistency, it also introduces VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) as reconstruction priors to represent the 3D-aware global state. MetaWorld ( Hu et al., 2026 ) observes that the collection of multi-view data is prohibitively expensive, thereby decomposing the camera ego-motion and object trajectories for data scaling. MultiGen ( Po et al., 2026 ) breaks down the function in diffusion game engines into memory module, observation module, and dynamic module. Similar to our insight, Prisma-World ( Sun et al., 2026 ) also views scene geometry as significant cues in 3D-aware consistent video generation. However, it only injects the relative camera pose into DiT for geometrical awareness, without explicit 3D maps.

paragraphs.en: We construct MA-CARLA , a synchronized multi-agent driving dataset rendered in CARLA Dosovitskiy et al. (2017) . It contains 11,283 rendered sequences derived from 2,478 unique synchronized trajectories across eight towns and 17 weather presets. The dataset includes 6,020 two-agent sequences with static backgrounds, 3,382 two-agent sequences with dynamic backgrounds containing non-agent actors, and 1,881 three-agent sequences with static backgrounds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 MA-CARLA，这是一个在 CARLA Dosovitskiy et al. (2017) 中渲染的同步多智能体驾驶数据集。 它包含 11,283 个渲染序列，这些序列源自八个城镇和 17 种天气预设中的 2,478 条独特的同步轨迹。 该数据集包括 6,020 个具有静态背景的双智能体序列、3,382 个包含非智能体角色的动态背景双智能体序列，以及 1,881 个具有静态背景的三智能体序列。

paragraphs.en: Candidate trajectories are generated using rule-based templates for opposing, following, and overtaking configurations, with route variants that may include turns. After trajectory-level filtering, accepted motions are replayed under different weather conditions while preserving agent motion and synchronization. Each rendered sequence contains 256 synchronized timestamps. Each vehicle is configured with four selected views—front, front-left, front-right, and rear—at 800 × 600 800\times 600 resolution, together with motion annotations and camera calibration. Across the two-agent sequences, MA-CARLA provides approximately 19.3M available RGB images. Fig. 2 visualizes representative samples and summarizes post-hoc motion groups extracted from recorded trajectories. A sequence may belong to multiple motion groups, yielding 17,790 group assignments in total. Fig. 2 reports their distribution by motion group and agent count. Appendix A.1 provides further details on data collection, grouping criteria, camera configurations, and data splits.
paragraphs.zh: 候选轨迹基于规则模板生成，涵盖对向、跟随和超车场景，路线变体可能包含转向动作。 在轨迹层级筛选后，被接受的运动将在不同天气条件下重演，同时保持智能体的运动与同步性。 每个渲染序列包含 256 个同步的时间戳。 每辆车均配置了四个选定的视角——正面、左前、右前和后方——分辨率为 800 × 600，并附带运动标注和相机校准信息。 在双智能体序列中，MA-CARLA 提供了约 1930 万张可用的 RGB 图像。 图 2 展示了代表性样本，并总结了从记录轨迹中提取的后验运动组。 一个序列可能属于多个运动组，总计产生 17,790 个分组分配。 图 2 报告了这些分组按运动组和智能体数量的分布情况。 附录 A.1 提供了关于数据收集、分组标准、相机配置和数据划分的更多细节。

paragraphs.en: We preprocess synchronized CARLA videos into geometry-aware conditioning signals. For each agent–camera streaming sequence, LingBot-Map ( Chen et al., 2026b ) is used to estimates dense depth, intrinsics, and camera poses in a consistent local coordinate system. The same estimates are used for point lifting, proxy fitting, and control rendering to preserve the non-metric scale. Grounded-SAM2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) extracts candidate dynamic masks, associated with either action-controlled agents or uncontrolled actors using CARLA metadata and calibrated projections. We exclude both categories from static-map fusion. Controlled agents are fitted as full-covariance 3D Gaussian proxies, while uncontrolled actors are stored as time-stamped observations rather than assigned future trajectories as in Fig. 3 . Artemis then renders a unified 24-channel control tensor consisting of background RGB/depth, proxy RGB/depth, a synthesis mask, uncontrolled-history RGB/depth, and an age mask within a certain historical window.

paragraphs.en: Overall Pipeline. As in Fig. 4 , we first initialize a shared static world map from the agents’ initial observations with LingBot-Map ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , a feed-forward foundation model for streaming 3D reconstruction, where submaps from all agents are registered in a common coordinate system. Given the input actions, we derive agent trajectories and render foreground-background disentangled control maps from the reconstructed world ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Specifically, controlled-agent proxies fitted from the first frames are propagated along these trajectories, with visibility-triggered agent insertion when needed. We render the static map, controlled proxies, and available uncontrolled dynamics observation history into a unified set of controls for the planned camera views, encoding both geometry and historical dynamics. Afterwards, a GeoAdapter module injects these controls into a pre-trained video diffusion transformer, Wan2.2 5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , which jointly generates synchronized future frames for all agents. Another cross attention layer ( Savva et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) is also designed to communicate inter-agent information in latent space. After generation, reconstructed static content updates the shared map, and accepted uncontrolled dynamics update their 3D history. Clean generated latents also update the implicit per-agent historical memories in KV-Cache for autoregressive online rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 整体流程。 如图 4 所示，我们首先利用 LingBot-Map（Chen et al., 2026b）——一个用于流式三维重建的前馈基础模型——从智能体的初始观测数据中初始化一个共享的静态世界地图，其中所有智能体的子地图都被注册到同一个公共坐标系中。 根据输入动作，我们从重建的世界中推导出智能体轨迹，并渲染出前景与背景分离的控制图（Yang et al., 2026）。 具体而言，从第一帧拟合出的受控智能体代理会沿着这些轨迹传播，并在必要时根据可见性触发智能体的插入。 我们将静态地图、受控代理以及可用的未受控动态观测历史渲染为一个统一的控制集，用于规划后的相机视角，其中同时编码了几何结构和历史动态信息。 随后，一个 GeoAdapter 模块将这些控制信息注入到预训练的视频扩散变换器 Wan2.2 5B（Wan et al., 2025）中，该模型会联合生成所有智能体的同步未来帧。 此外，还设计了一个交叉注意力层（Savva et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026），用于在潜在空间中传递智能体间的信息。 生成完成后，重建的静态内容会更新共享地图，而被接受的未受控动态则会更新其三维历史数据。 干净的生成潜在表示还会更新 KV-Cache 中每个智能体的隐式历史记忆，以支持自回归式的在线推理。

paragraphs.en: Future videos are jointly conditioned by historical observations and the input actions of each agent. paragraphs.en: To enhance cross-agent consistency and achieve progressive state update, we design three world update mechanisms for static background, uncontrolled dynamics, and agent pose, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 为了增强智能体间的连贯性并实现渐进式状态更新，我们分别为静态背景、非受控动态和智能体姿态设计了三种世界更新机制。

paragraphs.en: Static Map Update. After each rollout, we will select a few keyframes from newly generated frames in the block to update the unified 3D world map. The chosen keyframes are the frames introducing unseen scenarios or sharing low overlap with historical observations. The final world map is updated by merging the original static geometry map and the newly recovered submap reconstructed from keyframes.
paragraphs.zh: 静态地图更新。 每次执行 rollout 后，我们将从该区块中新生成的帧中选取几个关键帧，以更新统一的三维世界地图。 所选的关键帧是那些引入了未见过的场景或与历史观测数据重叠度较低的帧。 最终的世界地图通过将原始静态几何地图与根据关键帧重建的新恢复子地图合并而更新。

For each uncontrolled segmented dynamics, we update the history 3D buffer using a first-in-first-out principle, discarding the farthest frames while dynamically retaining the latest frame. In this case, the future positions can be extrapolated from the progressively updated historical motion priors.

paragraphs.en: Structured Pose Memory Maintenance. For each controllable agent, we maintain their historical poses across rollout blocks, so that an agent can remain geometrically consistent even when it is temporarily occluded or outside the observer’s sight. If one agent is not visible in the current frame, the generation model cannot generate it in the following block as original control maps fail to aware its existence through current frame segmentation. To address this issue, we design a pose-guided verification module based on maintained pose memory as in Fig. 5 . If no proxy is available is the current frame but the target’s planned poses indicate potential entry into the observer’s field of view, we initialize a conservative vehicle-shaped Gaussian and integrate it with the target position. This procedure allows the model to possess a global awareness of each agent’s location and feasibly supports the generation of newly visible controlled agents at any timestamp.

paragraphs.en: Artemis is built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B DiT ( Wan et al., 2025 ) backbone. We use a three-stage training recipe with Diffusion-Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) tailored for multi-agent online rollout. In Stage 1, we train the bidirectional model on paired CARLA videos with 15-channel geometric control maps using AdamW with an initial learning rate of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} , 200 warmup steps, and cosine decay on 32 H20 GPUs. In Stage 2, we initialize from the Stage-1 checkpoint and finetune it using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and 400 warmup steps. Both stages are trained on 81-frame clips at 256 × 416 256\times 416 resolution with flow matching, 1000 training timesteps, and flow shift γ = 5.0 \gamma=5.0 . During online inference, we generate 81-frame videos block by block with 5-frame denoising blocks and a 33-frame history window, using 50-step Euler sampling, guidance scale η = 1.0 \eta=1.0 . For stage-3 distillation, a causal generator is optimized with DMD-style distillation with 5-frame blocks and a 2-step denoising schedule.
paragraphs.zh: Artemis 构建于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B DiT（Wan 等人，2025）骨干模型之上。 我们采用三阶段训练方案，结合 Diffusion-Forcing（Chen 等人，2024）和 Self-Forcing（Huang 等人，2025），专为多智能体在线部署而设计。 在第一阶段，我们使用 AdamW 优化器，初始学习率设为 4 × 10⁻⁵，设置 200 个预热步数，并采用余弦退火策略，在 32 块 H20 GPU 上，基于带 15 通道几何控制图的配对 CARLA 视频训练双向模型。 在第二阶段，我们从第一阶段检查点初始化模型，并使用 AdamW 优化器进行微调，学习率设为 2 × 10⁻⁵，设置 400 个预热步数。 两个阶段均在分辨率为 256 × 416 的 81 帧视频片段上进行训练，采用流匹配方法，设置 1000 个训练时间步长和流偏移 γ = 5.0。 在线推理期间，我们以块为单位生成 81 帧视频，每个块包含 5 帧去噪单元和 33 帧历史窗口，并使用 50 步欧拉采样及引导系数 η = 1.0。 在第三阶段蒸馏中，我们通过 DMD 风格的蒸馏方法优化因果生成器，采用 5 帧块和 2 步去噪计划。

Since recent multi-agent world models are mostly still close-sourced, we choose a representative method Solaris ( Savva et al., 2026 ) , using implicit shared self-attention for cross-agent association. paragraphs.en: Evaluation Metrics. We report eight metrics covering both appearance fidelity and multi-agent consistency. For appearance metrics, we compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS between each generated video and its ground-truth video. For multi-agent consistency, we use DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) to process each generated video and estimate depth, camera intrinsics, and camera poses. Subject Consistency and Background Consistency evaluate the temporal stability of subject appearance and background structure, respectively. We also report the Aesthetic Quality and Imaging Quality, reflecting frame-level aesthetic appeal and overall perceptual quality, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 我们报告了八个涵盖外观保真度和多智能体一致性的指标。 对于外观指标，我们计算每段生成视频与其真实参考视频之间的 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS。 对于多智能体一致性，我们使用 DA3（Lin 等人，2025）处理每段生成视频，并估计深度、相机内参和相机姿态。 主体一致性和背景一致性分别评估主体外观和背景结构在时间上的稳定性。 我们还报告了美学质量和成像质量，分别反映帧级的美学吸引力以及整体的感知质量。

paragraphs.en: Comparison Results. As in Table 1 , our Artemis outperforms the baseline method Solaris and OASIS by a large margin in both appearance-related metrics and also consistency. Compared to Solaris, our Artemis achieves almost double SSIM, while reducing LPIPS to almost half. This proves that our rendered videos possess higher generation quality with an explicit geometry-guided paradigm and powerful generation priors from DiT. As for multi-agent consistency, our method also significantly surpasses Solaris in both cross-view consistency and trajectory consistency. This is mainly because implicit-only methods cannot recover underlying 3D world states, suffering from severe camera pose changes, occlusions, or few-shot views.
paragraphs.zh: 对比结果。 如表 1 所示，我们的 Artemis 在外观相关指标和一致性方面均大幅优于基线方法 Solaris 和 OASIS。 与 Solaris 相比，我们的 Artemis 实现了几乎两倍的 SSIM，同时将 LPIPS 降低至几乎一半。 这证明了我们渲染的视频具有更高的生成质量，其显式的几何引导范式以及来自 DiT 的强大生成先验共同促成了这一点。 在多智能体一致性方面，我们的方法在跨视角一致性和轨迹一致性上也显著优于 Solaris。 这主要是因为仅依赖隐式表示的方法无法恢复底层的三维世界状态，因此容易受到严重的相机姿态变化、遮挡或少数视角的影响。

paragraphs.en: Comparison with Implicit Multi-agent World Models. Previous multi-agent world models commonly adopt an implicit agent association manner, where cross-agent attention is introduced to exchange perspectives across agents. However, we observe that this implicit modeling can induce inconsistency geometry, especially for longer-sequence predictions. As in Fig. 6 , OASIS cannot handle the driving scenarios, with almost all blurry future imaginations. Although Solaris can generate basically reasonable geometry within the next 10 future frames, it suffers from artifact during long-horizon rollout. This illustrates that Solaris cannot learn genuine geometric consistency over time. In contrast, Artemis still forecasts accurate future videos over long sequences. We also visualize the uncontrolled dynamics in Fig. 7 , where two non-rigid bicyclists are predicted accurately.

paragraphs.en: For scalability beyond two agents, we extend the pairwise pipeline by treating each vehicle as an observer and all other vehicles as controlled targets. Unlike the two-agent case, where the visible foreground object can usually be assigned to the other agent directly, the multi-agent setting requires identity-aware target matching because each observer may see multiple vehicles. For each observer, detected vehicle masks are matched to the other agents using projected trajectories, proxy-track predictions, depth consistency, and image-space distance. The matched targets are then fitted as proxy Gaussians, rolled forward with their own trajectories, and merged into one dynamic control map for that observer. Online inference results of three agents are shown in Fig. 8 (b).
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现超过两个智能体的可扩展性，我们通过将每辆车视为观察者，并将所有其他车辆视为受控目标，来扩展成对处理流程。 与两个智能体的情况不同——在这种情况下，可见的前景物体通常可以直接分配给另一个智能体——多智能体设置需要基于身份识别的目标匹配，因为每个观察者都可能看到多辆车。 对于每个观察者，检测到的车辆掩码会通过投影轨迹、代理轨迹预测、深度一致性和图像空间距离与其余智能体进行匹配。 随后，匹配的目标会被拟合为代理高斯分布，沿着其自身的轨迹向前推进，并最终合并为该观察者的单一动态控制图。 三个智能体的在线推理结果如图 8 (b) 所示。

paragraphs.en: We conduct ablation studies to analyze the contribution of the geometric conditioning, online world update, and temporal memory mechanisms. The results are summarized in Table 2 . First, removing depth-related conditions consistently degrades reconstruction quality. This confirms that the dynamic proxy depth provide complementary geometric guidance. Second, disabling online world map update also hurts performance, reducing background and subject consistencies. This indicates that maintaining and updating the world representation during rollout is important for long-horizon consistency. Without map update, accumulated generation errors cannot be corrected by newly observed content, leading to weaker view reconstruction quality. Reducing the KV-cache with fewer historical frames also leads to worse perceptual quality and consistency. The result suggests that the causal KV-cache is important for preserving coherent autoregressive history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了消融研究，以分析几何条件约束、在线世界更新和时序记忆机制各自的贡献。 结果总结于表 2。 首先，移除与深度相关的条件会持续降低重建质量。 这证实了动态代理深度提供了互补的几何指导。 其次，禁用在线世界地图更新也会损害性能，降低背景和主体的连贯性。 这表明在推理过程中维持和更新世界表示对于长期一致性至关重要。 如果没有地图更新，累积的生成错误就无法通过新观察到的内容得到修正，导致视图重建质量下降。 减少历史帧数量以缩小 KV-cache 规模也会导致感知质量和连贯性变差。 结果表明，因果 KV-cache 对于保持连贯的自回归历史至关重要。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose a novel multi-agent world model which is anchored by reconstructed 3D world state. To incorporate large-scale dynamics, we curate a new driving dataset based on the CARLA simulator. Unlike previous methods mostly leveraging implicit cross-agent correlation, our Artemis can explicitly reconstruct and dynamically update a synchronized 3D world map. We also design a history 3D buffer for uncontrolled environmental dynamics, leveraging historical observations to predict their future motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed novelty, spatio-temporal consistency across frames, and scalability to more agent numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的多智能体世界模型，该模型以重建的三维世界状态为基础。 为了融入大规模动态变化，我们基于 CARLA 模拟器整理了一个新的驾驶数据集。 与以往主要依赖智能体间隐式相关性的方法不同，我们的 Artemis 能够显式地重建并动态更新同步的三维世界地图。 我们还为不受控制的环境动态设计了一个历史三维缓冲区，利用历史观测数据来预测其未来的运动。 广泛的实验证明了我们所提出创新方法的有效性，包括帧间时空一致性以及对更多智能体的可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: In preprocessing, each agent’s observation stream is reconstructed with LingBot-Map, which estimates dense depth, camera intrinsics, and camera poses in a consistent local coordinate gauge. We use these estimates jointly for background point lifting, controllable-proxy fitting, ambient-history lifting, and control-map rendering. CARLA annotations are used for identity association and motion supervision, but any metric quantities used by the renderer are converted into the LingBot-Map gauge before being combined with reconstructed geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 在预处理阶段，每个智能体的观察流都通过 LingBot-Map 进行重建，该工具可估算出稠密深度、相机内参以及相机姿态，并统一到一个一致的局部坐标系中。 我们将这些估算结果联合用于背景点提升、可控代理拟合、环境历史提升以及控制地图渲染。 CARLA 的标注被用于身份关联和运动监督，但渲染器使用的任何度量量值在与其他重建几何数据结合之前，都会先转换为 LingBot-Map 坐标系下的数值。

paragraphs.en: During online rollout, the initial observations define the reference scale and camera rig geometry. LingBot-Map reconstructs the initial local scene and provides the intrinsics and camera poses used for subsequent rendering and ray-map construction. User actions, inter-agent offsets, proxy extents, and generated-frame reconstructions are expressed in this same reference gauge before map fusion or dynamic-history insertion. Thus, Artemis maintains a single consistent geometric scale throughout autoregressive rollout, without requiring per-block scale re-estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 在线部署期间，初始观测值定义了参考标度和相机支架几何结构。 LingBot-Map 重建初始局部场景，并提供后续渲染和射线地图构建所需的内参及相机位姿。 在地图融合或动态历史插入之前，用户操作、智能体间偏移量、代理范围以及生成帧的重建结果均以相同的参考标度表示。 因此，Artemis 在整个自回归部署过程中保持单一一致的几何标度，无需对每个区块重新估计标度。

paragraphs.en: We design a three-stage training recipe using Diffusion-Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) and tailor them for multi-agent online rollout:
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种三阶段训练方案，该方案采用了扩散强制法（Chen 等人，2024）和自我强制法（Huang 等人，2025），并针对多智能体在线部署进行了优化：

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Bidirectional Teacher for Geometry Grounding. We first train a bidirectional teacher network to guarantee high-quality geometry reconstruction and effective control map injection. This stage jointly trains the cross-agent attention layer, GeoAdapter, and DiT on full sequences for all agents, using pre-processed control maps. Stage 1 can exploit larger temporal receptive field, cross-agent interactions, and spatio-temporal consistency, which serves as a real teacher for stage 3 distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：用于几何定位的双向教师模型。 我们首先训练一个双向教师网络，以确保高质量的几何重建和有效的控制图注入。 此阶段在完整序列上联合训练跨智能体注意力层、GeoAdapter 和 DiT，覆盖所有智能体，并使用预处理后的控制图。 阶段 1 可以利用更大的时间感受野、跨智能体交互以及时空一致性，从而为阶段 3 的知识蒸馏提供真实的教师模型。

sents.en: Stage 1: Bidirectional Teacher for Geometry Grounding.
sents.zh: 阶段 1：用于几何定位的双向教师模型。

sents.en: We first train a bidirectional teacher network to guarantee high-quality geometry reconstruction and effective control map injection.
sents.zh: 我们首先训练一个双向教师网络，以确保高质量的几何重建和有效的控制图注入。

sents.en: This stage jointly trains the cross-agent attention layer, GeoAdapter, and DiT on full sequences for all agents, using pre-processed control maps.

sents.en: Stage 1 can exploit larger temporal receptive field, cross-agent interactions, and spatio-temporal consistency, which serves as a real teacher for stage 3 distillation.
sents.zh: 阶段 1 可以利用更大的时间感受野、跨智能体交互以及时空一致性，从而为阶段 3 的知识蒸馏提供真实的教师模型。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2: Causal Student with Diffusion-Forcing. Stage 2 training is initialized based on the pretrained checkpoint form stage 1. However, we switch the temporally non-causal training in stage 1 to autoregressive training with causal masks using Diffusion-Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Variant noise scales are implemented on different video frames in DiT, while the noise scales for various agents are also independently sampled. Notably, the generation process is still established on full frame sequences in a single forward pass.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2：具有扩散强制的因果学生模型。 阶段 2 的训练基于阶段 1 的预训练检查点初始化。 然而，我们将阶段 1 中时间上非因果的训练方式切换为使用扩散强制（Chen et al., 2024）的因果掩码自回归训练。 DiT 中对不同视频帧采用了变体噪声尺度，同时各智能体的噪声尺度也独立采样。 值得注意的是，生成过程仍然在一次前向传播中基于完整的帧序列进行。

sents.en: Stage 2: Causal Student with Diffusion-Forcing.
sents.zh: 阶段 2：具有扩散强制的因果学生模型。

sents.en: Stage 2 training is initialized based on the pretrained checkpoint form stage 1.
sents.zh: 阶段 2 的训练基于阶段 1 的预训练检查点初始化。

sents.en: However, we switch the temporally non-causal training in stage 1 to autoregressive training with causal masks using Diffusion-Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 然而，我们将阶段 1 中时间上非因果的训练方式切换为使用扩散强制（Chen et al., 2024）的因果掩码自回归训练。

sents.en: Variant noise scales are implemented on different video frames in DiT, while the noise scales for various agents are also independently sampled.
sents.zh: DiT 中对不同视频帧采用了变体噪声尺度，同时各智能体的噪声尺度也独立采样。

sents.en: Notably, the generation process is still established on full frame sequences in a single forward pass.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，生成过程仍然在一次前向传播中基于完整的帧序列进行。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3: Self-Forcing-based Distillation. For stage 3, we leverage online streaming rollout, autoregressively generating videos based on history self-rollouts in a chunk-wise paradigm ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , as in Sec. 4.1 . This step reduces the diffusion denoising process into fewer steps which improves online inference efficiency. Specifically, control maps are first online rendered from the initialized 3D reconstructed world and intermediate actions. Then, latent frames are generated causally, where each agent will maintain an independent KV Cache to store its own historical latent frames as memory. Finally, the generated chunk is decoded into current videos, which are then used to reconstruct the updated 3D world map. We instantiate three models with identical architectures but distinct roles: a causal generator initialized from stage 2, a frozen bidirectional real teacher initialized from stage 1, and a trainable bidirectional fake critic, also initialized from stage 1. The real teacher represents the data distribution learned from the real videos, whereas the fake critic continuously tracks the evolving distribution induced by the causal generator.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 3：基于自强制的蒸馏。 在阶段 3 中，我们利用在线流式展开，以分块模式根据历史自展开结果自回归地生成视频（Huang 等，2025），如第 4.1 节所述。 此步骤将扩散去噪过程简化为更少的步骤，从而提高了在线推理效率。 具体而言，控制图首先从初始化的三维重建世界和中间动作中在线渲染。 然后，潜在帧以因果方式生成，其中每个智能体都将维护一个独立的 KV 缓存，用于存储其自身的历史潜在帧作为记忆。 最后，生成的分块被解码为当前视频，这些视频随后用于重建更新后的三维世界地图。 我们实例化了三个架构相同但角色不同的模型：一个从阶段 2 初始化的因果生成器、一个从阶段 1 初始化的冻结双向真实教师模型，以及一个同样从阶段 1 初始化的可训练双向虚假批评者模型。 真实教师模型代表从真实视频中学习到的数据分布，而虚假批评者模型则持续追踪由因果生成器引发的不断演变的分布。
